title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
abstract: arXiv:2611.26540v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding

translated_title: AURA：音频驱动的流式虚拟形象
translated_abstract: 当前的音频驱动视频扩散模型能够合成逼真的说话人头视频，但通常需要在多秒的视频片段上进行数十步扩散去噪，这使它们不适合语音助手和虚拟化身等流式应用，而这些应用要求低延迟和在线因果生成。AURA 通过滚动 KV 缓存逐块生成视频，只需当前块的音频即可开始生成，而不像双向模型那样需要多秒的音频前瞻。它提供两种规模：AURA 1.3B 可在单块 GPU 上实时流式生成 576p 视频（在 16 Hz 播放速率下达到 20.7 fps），适合交互式虚拟形象应用；AURA 5B 则能以 9.7 fps 流式生成 720p 视频。我们的两阶段蒸馏流水线首先通过训练因果学生模型以更少的扩散步骤和逐块滑动窗口来匹配教师的轨迹，从而将学生与教师对齐……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了 AURA——一种音频驱动的流式数字人视频生成模型，通过滚动 KV 缓存实现逐块因果生成，并配合两阶段蒸馏，可在单 GPU 上以 20.7 fps 实时流式生成 576p 说话人视频，适用于低延迟交互式虚拟形象应用。
en_tdlr: AURA is an audio-driven streaming avatar model that generates talking-head video chunk-by-chunk using a rolling KV cache and a two-stage distillation pipeline, enabling real-time 576p video streaming (20.7 fps) on a single GPU for low-latency interactive applications.
